instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Make a referral code that earns what my referral reward rules give, and give back the event to save", and give it rules (the person's referral reward rule rows); referrer (The account that shares the code); target (The sale attribute and the value a sale must have to earn this code).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:make-a-referral-code and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Makes a short readable code (letters and digits, no I, L, O or U, so it survives being read aloud) or checks the one you chose, and gives back the event that makes it live once the person saves it.
4. It reads and keeps nothing: it works from your request and answers its whole result; you keep any row it hands back.
